name: update-ledger
description: Multi-workspace chronological work ledger. Pulls Jira tickets, GitHub PRs, and Codeberg/Forgejo PRs per workspace (company, solo, client), writes immutable event entries, regenerates per-entity rollups, and produces daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly summaries plus cross-workspace timelines. Survives job changes — workspaces are pluggable. Supports manual notes for work not in Jira/PRs. Delegates per-item composition to cheap haiku subagents to keep main-thread context small.
